full_judgment: 9. It will not be out of place of to mention here that this Court consistently declared the enlistment of any property after 1974 as vested property as illegal and without lawful Authority as the law of enemy property became inoperative and no property could be declared as enemy property after the repeal of Ordinance No.1 of 1965 on 23.03.1974, reference in this regard may be had to the cases reported in 32 DLR (AD) 70 and 186.
